JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
JOIN code.call_edges ce ON ce.caller_symbol_id = s.symbol_id AND ce.callee_symbol_id = cb.base_symbol_id AND ce.caller_kind = 'method' AND ce.callee_kind = 'method'

  AND s.name = cb.base_name
GROUP BY s.symbol_id
ORDER BY s.symbol_id

request:
Which methods of the Group class in src/click/core.py override a method that its base class Command (same file) defines itself under the same name? Count only methods written in the body of Command, not ones Command inherits; __init__ counts as an override. Give the symbol ID of the Group method.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: The query filters files by the exact file_id 'core.py' and package 'click' to locate the Group class and its Command base methods, then identifies overrides via call edges where the method name matches the base method name.
sql:
SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.class_bases cb ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
JOIN code.call_edges ce ON ce.caller_symbol_id = s.symbol_id AND ce.callee_symbol_id = cb.base_symbol_id AND ce.caller_kind = 'method' AND ce.callee_kind = 'method'
JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
WHERE f.file_id = 'core.py'
  AND f.package = 'click'
  AND s.qualname LIKE 'Group.%'
  AND cb.base_name = 'Command'
  AND cb.class_symbol_id IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE qualname = 'Command' AND file_id = s.file_id)
  AND s.name = cb.base_name
GROUP BY s.symbol_id
ORDER BY s.symbol_id
